title: Barcelona Modernist Printing House
identity_statement: A compact two-storey Barcelona Modernista printing house: warm red brick infill is held inside a black iron structural grid; three front bays and four side bays contain tall ground-floor glazing and upper round arches; four lobed brick parapet centers and corner pylons surround a flat roof with a central T-shaped glazed lantern.

measured_contract.asymmetry: street entrance occupies the center front ground bay; the roof lantern forms an offset T plan despite the otherwise four-sided envelope
source_conflicts: The family prose mentions a sawtooth roof, but the exact variant-2 top image proves a flat roof with a T-shaped glazed lantern; the image controls.

plan_and_roof_graph.plan: single closed 15 m x 18 m rectangular workshop envelope
plan_and_roof_graph.structure: black iron corner posts, intermediate bay columns, floor beam, cornice beam, and visible roof-edge frame
plan_and_roof_graph.roof: closed flat weathering plane behind a low brick-and-iron parapet; four centered lobed brick gables; raised brick corner pylons; central T-shaped glazed lantern with pitched panes and closed end walls
plan_and_roof_graph.circulation: center-front double-leaf entrance leads directly into the open printing hall; rear service door remains connected to the same floor plate

bay_schedule.ground_front: three full-height glazed/door bays between iron columns, with center delivery entrance
bay_schedule.upper_front: three tall round-arched multi-lite windows in brick infill
bay_schedule.ground_sides: four tall glazed workshop bays on each side
bay_schedule.upper_sides: four round-arched multi-lite windows on each side
bay_schedule.rear: three-bay continuation of the same structural and opening grammar with one service entrance

required_objects: warm task lighting located inside the room rather than on the glass

registered_identity_roles: bounded circular Modernista printing rosette and relief panel centered on each parapet gable

registered_identity.mapping: front-elevation iron-only UV sticker on a physical tawny-brick carrier exterior face; parapet silhouette and all brick remain geometry

dominant_source_conditioned_roles: pale limestone/concrete plinth and opening returns

mapping.iron_and_timber: object length in real metres with consistent grain/finish scale

fragile_contacts: lantern end wall and glazing to flat roof curb
iron corner columns to stone plinth and cornice
